newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 26.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 26.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:
* A wave of buying sent stocks leaping to a record close on Friday as Wall Street prepared for the three-day Memorial Day holiday weekend.
* The death toll from a shopping centre fire and riot in the South Kalimantan city of Banjarmasin on the island of Borneo has risen to 142, the local Dinamika Berita reported on Monday.

The riot began on Friday as supporters of the Moslem-oriented United Development Party (PPP) began to intercept and harass people on their way to a rally of the ruling Golkar party on the final day of Indonesia's violence-plagued election campaign.

* On Friday, the Jakarta composite index ended up on the back of minor buying in blue chips despite unfounded rumours of unrest in the capital on the last day of the general election campaign, brokers said. The Jakarta Composite Index closed 4.43 points at 658.52 points.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,440.50/41.50 at 0130 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,440.00/42.00.
* Secondary plastic firm Dynaplast on news reports the firm planned to buy a 26-percent stake in an Indian plastic packaging firm.

* Pulp and paper maker Indah Kiat on its plan to seek shareholders' approval for its rights issue at an extraordinary meeting on June 21. The company recently announced a 45-for-50 rights issue at 1,000 rupiah, attached with 14 warrants.
* Bank Niaga, Lippo Bank and Semen Gresik after announcements of first quarter results.
* Small tourism services firm Bayu Buana on reports of a possible financial restructuring.
* Small property firm Mas Murni on market talk of a possible take-over.
* Surya Dumai after the timber firm announced it had decided to change the use of a part of its IPO proceeds.
